reviewed_by: Codex focused review for searchable Assistant model picker
reason: The changed journey is selecting a provider model from Assistant settings when the catalog is large. Three component cases cover name, ID and description filtering, keyboard movement, selection and empty states. Six collected browser cases cover Assistant settings in desktop Chromium, mobile Chromium and mobile WebKit, including 320 and 430 px geometry checks for the searchable picker.
exclusions: No Python or native source changes. Unrelated UI and Playwright suites are excluded. The browser fixtures use a mock Core; real-Core persistence, LAN origin and physical-device behavior remain separate verification gates.
